purpose: Form MSC-1 is used to apply to the Registrar to obtain the status of a dormant company under section 455.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Check company eligibility under the rules.
Pass a special resolution in the general meeting or issue a notice to all shareholders and obtain consent of at least 3/4th shareholders in value.
Prepare Form MSC-1 along with the required fee.
Submit Form MSC-1 to the Registrar.
checklist: No inspection, inquiry or investigation has been ordered, taken up or carried out against the company.
No prosecution has been initiated and pending against the company under any law.
The company does not have any outstanding public deposits and is not in default in payment thereof or interest thereon.
The company does not have any outstanding secured loan.
If there is any outstanding unsecured loan, obtain concurrence of the lender.
There is no dispute in the management or ownership of the company.
The company does not have any outstanding statutory taxes, dues, duties etc. payable to the government or local authorities.
The company has not defaulted in the payment of workmen's dues.
The securities of the company are not listed on any stock exchange within or outside India.
